name: FAKE ン RARE — Living Plate
description:
A Fake Rare that repaints itself.

The red banner carries one of the 500 highest-valued Fake Rares and turns every six hours. The seal beside the kanji carries the Bitcoin block that particular Fake Rare was issued in — its own place on the chain, not the chain's place today. The sweatshirt turns over every 24 hours between FAKE RARE and CAKE RARE.

There are 501 places in the rotation: the artist's own FAKE ン RARE first, then all 500 names, then home again. 501 x 6 hours = 3,006 hours = 125.25 days, so the plate returns to itself about three times a year. At the home plate the seal falls silent and the chest holds the artist's own F: the painting entire, with nothing added.

Neither letter on the sweatshirt is drawn by the program. The F is his. So is the C — lifted from a companion painting, matted off its canvas and colour-matched to this one. The piece never invents a brushstroke.

One self-verifying JSON holds the painting, the pigment and the engine, each blob carrying its own SHA-256. Nothing is fetched at run time. It runs offline, forever.
